text: Jade Hero
A Jade Guard soldier, having distinguished himself in battle, has earned the recognition of his comrades and superiors alike. Word of his acclaim has reached your ears.
Reward this man
You personally pour him wine, and present him with the sword you have carried at your side for many years.
Promote this man
Such a warrior deserves promotion, that he may serve Cathay all the better.
The troops' spirits are lifted, and all long to fight the enemy with renewed vigour.
A subordinate general with a unique trait joins your army.
Lady of Nan Gau

The stronghold of the Great Bastion has been completed, and the war is about to enter its next phase. Travel-worn, the Lady of Nan Gau arrives with her honour guard, and you sense keenly that her gaze falls upon you - the look one gives when appraising a finely-crafted weapon. You have become the very blade of the gods she hoped for, one to be aimed at the north beyond the Great Bastion.\\nA council of war convenes without warning. Cold, uncompromising, and efficient - this is ever the way of the Raging Gale. And now, she wishes to hear your proposal first.
Pincer Formation

You believe the Great Bastion garrison and Miao Ying's honour guard should be stationed separately, forming a pincer to leave the enemy with nowhere to turn. To fulfil this role, however, the Great Bastion garrison will require further reinforcement.
Unite the Armies
The time has come; the northern armies should unite as one and strike with the force of thunder, repaying the suffering brought by the great enemy of Chaos a hundredfold.
The Frontier Guard faction remains independent, but you will receive a steady stream of aid from Nan Gau, and form a military alliance with the Northern Provinces faction.
Confederate with the Northern Provinces faction.
Aid from Nan Gau

A startled warhorse gallops shrieking through the camp, kicking over countless weapon racks and tents along the way. Soldiers scatter in alarm, forgetting all discipline for the moment. The subordinate general, furious, moves to restore order - but turning around, he too is startled. Beyond the camp, a vast convoy of transport wagons stretches out like a wall of men and beasts. The banners on the wagons reveal that they hail from Nan Gau.\\nThis event will trigger again after 15 turns.
Imperial Reinforcements
A force of elite reinforcements will prove decisive in this campaign.
Arms of Nan Gau
Fine equipment is a soldier's second life.
Army of the Dragon God
Miao Ying's army shall become the blade driven into the enemy's very heart.
One United Body
The Great Bastion and the Northern Provinces become one once more, but the highest glory of defeating the great enemy of Chaos shall belong to the Governor of the Northern Provinces.
An elite army will muster at Po Mei.
Gain the Banner of Nan Gau and the Shield of Nan Gau.
Miao Ying's army appears near the faction leader.
Confederate with the Northern Provinces faction.
Return of the Defier of Fate
Xin Wu has drawn sufficient strength from his slumber. He has now returned, willing to fight for Cathay.
Unite Against the Enemy
Cathay, as it stands, must seize every ounce of strength available if it hopes to return to peace. Though Xin Wu's arrival may stir up much fear, you still wish for him to become your ally.
Blade of Chaos

You have found the perfect use for Xin Wu - to send him deep into the Chaos Wastes, disrupting the invading Chaos army's mustering rhythm as much as possible through his slaughter. This, too, aligns with Xin Wu's own desire.
For a time, Xin Wu will become your ally.
Great Bastion Threat: -20%
Defier of Fate
Army Ability: '[Defier of Fate]'\\n(In regions controlled by Cathay)
Quell Within, Repel Without

The Great Bastion remains at peace for now, yet Cathay itself is not so tranquil. You ponder whether to have Fu Yuanshan temporarily set aside his duties defending the Great Bastion, entrusting them to another, so that he may aid you in quelling the unrest within Cathay.
Order Within First
You intend for this man to first help you pacify Cathay, then turn to repel the enemy without.
Repel the Enemy First
The great enemy of Chaos cannot be taken lightly for even a single day; the petty unrest within Cathay's borders can be settled in but a moment.
